details: Cryptocurrencies rebounded on November 4, 2026, after experiencing initial losses following the Democratic Party's capture of both houses of the US Congress in the midterm elections. Bitcoin saw a recovery, trading around $78,354, while Ether gained to $2,323, mirroring a broader upswing in stock markets. The crypto industry had invested over $300 million in lobbying efforts for favorable deregulation, a stance that may face challenges under the new congressional landscape.
title: US Midterm Elections: Crypto Market Recovers Post-Democrat Win

details: New information on November 4, 2026, reveals that hackers stole an estimated $6.3 billion from Binance by compromising employees through fake job interviews and malicious software, with the initial breach traced back to June. Following the incident, attributed by the FBI to a North Korean hacking group, Binance customers have withdrawn a net $4.72 billion from the exchange. Binance has committed to covering all losses with company funds, having already secured $6 billion, but the event continues to highlight the vulnerabilities of digital assets and could impact institutional confidence.
title: Binance Hack: New Details Emerge Amid Continued Withdrawals
